sources.title: Google: Gemini 3.8 Live + Extended Thinking (Sep 15)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Google Sep 15 launches Gemini 3.8 Live (scale/cost efficiency, fluid dialogue, visual grounding) and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking (high-complexity multi-step reasoning); native speech-to-speech with interruptions, 97 mid-conversation languages, real-time visual context, background tool/API execution with live narration.
claims.context: Announcement lede and model definitions as stated.

claims.text: Extended Thinking: #1 Artificial Analysis Speech-to-Speech Quality Index 82.6; 68.6% tau-Voice; 35.1% tau-Voice-banking (Sierra); 97.7% Big Bench Audio. Live: 2nd Speech Agent Arena (preference). EVA-Bench (ServiceNow) Pareto-frontier claim for complex workflows.
claims.context: Benchmark section as stated; third-party names cited by vendor; unreproduced here.

claims.text: Available via Gemini Live API, AI Studio, Gemini Enterprise private preview (Vertex), Gemini app, Search Live, Workspace (Docs/Gmail/Keep Live); platform integrations (Agora, Fishjam, LangChain, LiveKit, Pipecat, Vercel, Vision Agents) and design partners (Salesforce, Genspark, Lumeris, ServiceNow et al.) as first-party stated; generated audio SynthID-watermarked with published audio model card.

limitations.text: All benchmark figures vendor-reported; scoring methodology and independent reproduction not consumed.
